杨厂长走后，吴志强直接去了门房，关上门，吴志强就把杨厂长说的事儿，原原本本的跟赵爷爷说了一遍。

赵爷爷气呼呼的说道：“这帮王八犊子，为了两个糟子儿，什么都干的出来！去把小野叫过来。”

吴志强说道：“师父，小野还小吧，让他参与进来好吗？”

赵爷爷没好气的说道：“这小子粘上毛比猴都精，用你操心呀！得让他手里有过硬的功劳，要不然，天天闲着迟早出事儿！”

没一会儿，吴志强就带着王野来到了门房。吴志强又把杨厂长的话给王野重复了一遍，王野疑惑的问：“赵爷爷，有贼就抓贼呗！找我干嘛？”

赵爷爷说：“找你当然是让你暗中调查呀！”

王野苦笑着说：“赵爷爷，我觉得我不需要什么功劳，现在这样我觉得挺好的。”

赵爷爷笑骂说：“放屁！一天两天没事儿，要是时间长了呢？你一天天屁活儿不干，被有心人注意到，你就是人家手里的功绩了。”

王野无所谓的说：“那就降级呗！反正他们开除不了我。”

赵爷爷气的胡子都要立起来了说：“你还要脸不？降级很光荣呀？你不嫌丢人我还嫌丢人呢！我说的这事儿必须你办，还得给我办好了！”

王野说：“赵爷爷，这事儿我一听就猜个八九不离十了，很麻烦的，弄不好就是打不到狐狸惹一身骚。”

赵爷爷眼睛一亮说：“哦？那你说说，怎么个八九不离十。”

王野没精打采的说：“轧钢厂丢东西，还是钢材，这事儿从三方面下手就能猜出来，卖方，买方，操作人。买方范围很小，钢材这东西，老百姓一般不用，所以黑市上出现的很少。而迫切想得到咱们厂子钢材的，不一定是为了卖钱，我觉得钢材的性能才是他们的目的。”

“这就锁定目标了，十有八九是特务。咱们的技术人家看不上，他们要的应该是工厂的动态。我猜测上面应该是有什么关于钢材的指示，他们是要验证消息的真伪。”

“卖方更好猜了，一个多月了才被发现，说明涉及的人位置肯定不低，这么久了，一个中层肯定捂不住，上层就那么几个人。一筛查就知道了。中间经手人肯定是仓库里的人，外人想进去都难，想瞒着算了吧，就算是仓库门口拴条狗，这事也早就曝光了。”

吴志强说：“既然这么简单，那抓人就行了呗？”

王野叹了口气说：“师父，你觉得杨厂长是傻子吗？他会想不到......。”

刚说完这句话，王野脑子“嗡”的一下不说话了：“卧槽！我知道前世吴志强为什么捡破烂了。踏马的，这是让人当枪使了。”

杨厂长踏马的这也不是个好人呀！顺着事倒着推，如果这次涉及到未来的李副厂长，起风后这老王八蛋一定会报复吴志强，到时候没了赵爷爷这个靠山，吴志强一定被整得很惨。

“小野，小野想什么呢？”吴志强一边扒拉王野一边叫着。

被吴志强从思绪中叫醒，王野无精打采的说：“师父，这事能推了吗？”

吴志强说：“你说呢？这是咱保卫科的职责，我往哪儿推？”

赵爷爷说：“怎么，很麻烦吗？”

王野说：“赵爷爷，想必您也看出来了，杨厂长这老阴逼，是要把我师父当枪使，这里边应该连您老也算计进去了。”

赵爷爷说：“这我知道，这点算计我还是能接住的。”

王野继续说：“赵爷爷，在这个厂子里，有个人很特殊，他就是后勤主任。这个笑面虎后台很硬。硬到杨厂长也拿他没办法。”

赵爷爷说：“我知道这个人，他的关系应该在部里。具体是谁我没查过。”

王野说：“假设这次李主任涉及其中，最后不论这个李主任会不会出问题，我觉得师父你肯定吃不着好果子。他杨厂长就能坐山观虎斗了。”

After Director Yang left, Wu Zhiqiang went directly to the concierge, closed the door, and Wu Zhiqiang told Grandpa Zhao exactly what Director Yang said.

Grandpa Zhao said angrily: "These bastards will do anything for these two bastards! Go and call Xiaoye over."

Wu Zhiqiang said: "Master, Xiaoye is still young, can you let him participate?"

Grandpa Zhao said angrily: "This kid is better than a monkey when it comes to gluing hair, so you have to worry about him! He has to have strong achievements in his hands, otherwise, something will happen sooner or later if he is idle every day!"

After a while, Wu Zhiqiang brought Wang Ye to the concierge.Wu Zhiqiang repeated what Director Yang said to Wang Ye. Wang Ye asked doubtfully: "Grandpa Zhao, if there are thieves, just catch them! Why are you looking for me?"

Grandpa Zhao said: "Of course I want you to investigate secretly!"

Wang Ye smiled bitterly and said: "Grandpa Zhao, I don't think I need any credit. I think it's pretty good like this."

Grandpa Zhao laughed and scolded: "Fart! It's okay for a day or two, but what if it takes a long time? If you don't do any work every day, and someone who cares notices you, you will be a credit to others."

Wang Ye said nonchalantly: "Then I'll demote you! They can't fire me anyway."

Grandpa Zhao's beard stood up in anger and said: "Do you still want shame? Is it honorable to be demoted? If you don't think it's embarrassing, I still think it's embarrassing! You have to do this thing I said, and you have to do it for me!"

Wang Ye said: "Grandpa Zhao, I immediately guessed it as soon as I heard about it. It's very troublesome. Maybe I won't be able to hit the fox and make myself embarrassed."

Grandpa Zhao's eyes lit up and he said, "Oh? Then tell me, why are we so inseparable?"

Wang Ye said listlessly: "What is lost in the steel rolling mill is steel. This can be guessed from three aspects, the seller, the buyer, and the operator. The scope of buyers is very small. Steel is generally not used by ordinary people, so there are very few on the black market. Those who are eager to get the steel from our factory are not necessarily selling it for money. I think the performance of the steel is their purpose."

"This is a target. It's most likely a spy. Our technicians don't like it. What they want is the factory's updates. I guess there should be some instructions about steel from above, and they want to verify the authenticity of the information."

"The seller had a better guess. It took more than a month for him to be discovered, which means that the people involved must have a high position. After such a long time, a middle-level person must not be able to cover it up, and there are just a few people at the upper level. It will be known after a screening. The middle-hand person must be someone from the warehouse. It is difficult for outsiders to get in. If you want to hide it, forget it. Even if there is a dog tied at the door of the warehouse, this matter will have been exposed long ago."

Wu Zhiqiang said: "If it's so simple, then just arrest people?"

Wang Ye sighed and said: "Master, do you think Director Yang is a fool? He would not have thought of..."

As soon as he finished saying this, Wang Ye's mind buzzed and he stopped talking: "Fuck! I know why Wu Zhiqiang was picking up rags in his previous life. He's riding a horse, he's being used as a gunman."

Director Yang is not a good person either!Going forward, if the future deputy director Li is involved this time, the old bastard will definitely take revenge on Wu Zhiqiang after the wind rises. By then, without Grandpa Zhao as his backer, Wu Zhiqiang will definitely be dealt a terrible blow.

"Xiaoye, what are you thinking about?" Wu Zhiqiang shouted while pulling at Wang Ye.

Being awakened from his thoughts by Wu Zhiqiang, Wang Ye said listlessly: "Master, can this matter be postponed?"

Wu Zhiqiang said: "What do you think? This is the responsibility of our security department, where should I push it?"

Grandpa Zhao said: "Why, is it troublesome?"

Wang Ye said: "Grandpa Zhao, you must have noticed that Director Yang, this old cunt, wants to use my master as a gunman, and you should be involved in this conspiracy."

Grandpa Zhao said: "I know this, I can still catch this calculation."

Wang Ye continued: "Grandpa Zhao, there is a very special person in this factory. He is the logistics director. This smiling tiger is very tough in the background. He is so tough that even Director Yang can't do anything to him."

Grandpa Zhao said: "I know this person, and his relationship should be in the ministry. I haven't checked who he is specifically."

Wang Ye said: "Assuming that Director Li is involved this time, no matter whether there will be problems with Director Li in the end, I think you will definitely not get a good harvest, Master. Director Yang can just sit back and watch the fight between tigers and tigers."
